Codecobo does not collect or upload any data. The app declares no network permission, contains no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting components, and needs no account.

Stored on this device
• Names and addresses of associated devices
• Saved audio configurations and automatic restore preferences
• App preferences such as theme, language, access method and status notification
• Diagnostics, kept as a rolling log and cleared from Activity log
This data is used only to read and restore audio settings, show the status notification and diagnose problems; it never leaves the app.

Permissions
• Nearby devices: read the audio settings of connected devices
• Notifications: show the persistent status notification
• Battery optimisation and background work: restore settings when a device reconnects
Permissions are requested only when you use the feature that needs them and can be revoked in Android settings at any time.

External links
Project links open in the system browser; those sites apply their own privacy policies.
